summary: The figure is a world map showing the annual mean concentrations of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) at the national level for 2019, with countries color-coded by concentration ranges. It also indicates whether rural areas have higher PM2.5 concentrations than towns or cities using purple circles and blue dots respectively. The highest concentrations (>35 µg/m³) are mainly observed in parts of Asia and Africa. Some countries have rural areas with higher PM2.5 than urban areas, as marked by the symbols.
